ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Page canvas, card surfaces, footer — the universal background. Cards do not lift from the canvas; they are demarcated only by hairline white borders

gallery-white.$description: Gallery White — Body text, headings, nav marks, hairline borders, link underlines, list dividers — the sole foreground. Used as 1px structural lines rather than fills

unica77-ll.$description: The entire interface speaks in a single weight of one custom neo-grotesque. Weight 400 only — no bold, no light, no italic. The signature is the binary scale: 12–18px functional metadata against an isolated 80px display, with nothing in between. This extreme jump is the hierarchy.
